Case ID: 1168
Case Type: IT Ticket
Date: 2025-04-05
Handled By: IT - Elena Voss
Customer or Requestor: Internal Team - Finance
Title: VPN instability during finance reconciliation window

Issue Description
Finance users reported repeated VPN disconnects during month-end reconciliation, interrupting access to shared reporting drives and payment review tools.

Steps Taken
- Checked network monitoring and identified session drops concentrated in one remote access gateway.
- Compared the timing with a recent configuration change deployed to the gateway pool.
- Redirected impacted users to a stable gateway while network engineering reviewed the change.
- Validated restored access with Finance leads and monitored session stability for the next two hours.

Resolution
Rolled back the faulty configuration on the affected gateway and maintained alternate routing until normal stability was confirmed.

Follow-Up
IT added a higher-change-control requirement for gateway updates during financial close periods.
